title: Reconnect Me
body:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fed909f0bdd8acbe6fc81e9b2bb16e77c7742471.png)

# Reconnect Button 
is a client-side QoL mod for Minecraft that adds a convenient reconnect button to the game.

The mod adds a Reconnect button to the pause menu under the Disconnect button, and also to the disconnect/kick screen under Back to Server List. With one click, you can quickly reconnect to the last multiplayer server you joined without going through extra menus.

## Features
Reconnect button in the pause menu
Reconnect button after being kicked or disconnected
Remembers your last multiplayer server
Settings through Mod Menu
Optional confirmation before reconnecting
Optional auto-reconnect with delay
Customizable button text
Fully client-side

## Why use it?

This mod is useful if you often play on PvP, minigame, survival, anarchy, or private servers where you may need to quickly reconnect after a kick, timeout, connection loss, or manual disconnect.

It does not change gameplay, does not automate in-game actions, and simply makes the normal reconnect process faster and more convenient.

![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50426835332189a05275cc2eca61c5b01a568c7e.png)

## Compatibility
Minecraft: 1.20.1 or 1.21.11
Loader: Fabric
Requires: Fabric API, Mod Menu, Cloth Config
